translation.name: Ilagano lya Katali, Ilagano Linyale kwa Wanhu Weng’ha

content: Musa kangupegwa ludali lwa kudita vinduzanduza
Musa nakamlonjela Mkulu Nguluwi, “Ila Waisilaeli hawokunda ne kunyhulichiza, hanji wolonga kota hegwe Nguluwi hundawile hebu.”
Aho Mkulu Nguluwi nakamuuza Musa, “Kibata choni mmoko mwa hegwe?” Musa nakamwidichila, “Ng'weku.”
Mkulu Nguluwi nakamlonjela, “Ulagaze hanyi.” Musa nakalagaza ng'hweku hanyi, nayo naigaluka kuwa izoka. Musa nakaibilima.
Ila Mkulu Nguluwi nakamlonjela Musa, “Ugolole moko wa hegwe, ulibate mchila.” Musa nakagolola moko wa heye, nakalibata, izoka naligaluka kuwa ng'hweku kahi mmoko mwa heye.

Mkulu Nguluwi nakamlonjela, “Ahyo, kwa chinduzanduza achi, Waisilaeli woweza kukunda kota heni nda Mkulu Nguluwi, Nguluwi wa wasekulu wa hewo na Nguluwi wa Abulahamu na Nguluwi wa Isaka na Nguluwi wa Yakobo, ndikulawila.”
Kahi, Mkulu Nguluwi nakamlonjela, “Winjize moko wa hegwe mli ikanzu lya hegwe.” Musa nakadita hiho, ila loyalavile kunze, baho uwa na uswema.

Hamba Nguluwi nakamlonjela, “Winjize kahi moko wa hegwe mli ikanzu lya hegwe.” Musa nakenjiza moko wa heye mli ikanzu lya heye. Loyaulavile kunze, baho du uwa goya kota vyoluwele lukuli lwa heye aho hamwande.
Nguluwi nakamlonjela Musa, “Wone hawokwidichila ama kukunda ulajilo wa mwaluko, hanji wokunda ulajilo lwa keli.
Ila wone hawakundile ne ulajilo awu weng'ha wili, ama kukunda ulonzi wa hegwe, kogadeha mazi ga lwanda lwa Naili na kugabohola mchanya mwa isi ng'havu. Mazi ago gowa danda mchanya mwa isi ng'havu.”
Ila Musa nakamlonjela Mkulu Nguluwi, “Dedede Mkulu wa heni, heni sidahile kulonga goya kulawila hamwande, hanga na hala houlonjile na heni chitumagwa wa hegwe, heni sidahile kulonga goya ng'hatu.”
Aho Mkulu Nguluwi nakamuuza, “Whaani yalumbile umyango wa munhu? Whaani yomdita munhu yalemwele kulonga na kuhulika? Whaani yomdita munhu yalole ama yawe hambe yalole? Ndaze, hawele Mkulu Nguluwi?
Lelo ulute. Heni ndoulongoza umyango wa hegwe na kukulangusa cha kulonga.”
Ila Musa nakalonga, “Hegwe Mkulu wa heni, dedede ndangukulanda, umlajize munhu yunji.”

Ndo baho kuzudila kwa Mkulu Nguluwi lolwachile kwa Musa, nakamlonjela, “Ndaze, kuduhu mng'holozo Aluni yawele Mlawi? Ndivizela heye kaweza kulonga goya. Kahi kanguya kuting'hana na hegwe, baho du hoyokona kosangalala ng'hatu mnhumbula.
Hegwe kolonga na heye na kumlonjela geng'ha goyolonga. Heni ndowatanzani na kuwalangusa mbuli za kudita.
Aluni kodawala na Waisilaeli honhu hako. Heye kowa yolonga honhu ha hegwe, nagwe kowa kota Nguluwi kwa heye.
Kochibata mmoko mwako ng'hweku ayi ndo ikutanza kudita ula ulajilo.”
Musa kanguhiluka Misili
Musa nakahiluka kwa Yesilo, mgosi wa heye, nakamlonjela, “Dedede ung'hundize nyhiluche Misili kwa wang'holozangu, ndikalole wone wawele wakomu.” Yesilo nakamlonjela, “Lute goya.”
Musa loyali yang'hali muisi ya Midiani, Mkulu Nguluwi nakamlonjela, “Uhiluche Misili kwa vila wala weng'ha nawaganile kukukopola nawabagama.”
Lelo Musa nakamhola mchewake na wanage, nakawakwiniza midogowi, nakaluka majendo ga kuhiluka Misili. Mmoko mwa heye nakahola yila ng'hweku yalonjelwe na Nguluwi yaihole.

Mkulu Nguluwi nakamlonjela Musa, “Loufika Misili, uwe uvizelele kota kudita hali Falao vinduzanduza vyeng'ha vyondikupele ludali lwa kudita. Ila heni ndoidita nhumbula ya Falao iwe igagadale, na heye howalechela Waisilaeli woche.
Nagwe komlonjela Falao kota Mkulu Nguluwi kangulonga ahi, ‘Isi ya Isilaeli ndo mlelwa wa heni wa mwaluko mlume.
Nani ndangukulonjela, Mleche mwanangu yoche leka yakafugamile heni. Wone uleme kumlechela yoche, ulole ndomkopola mlelwa wa hegwe wa mwaluko mlume.’ ”
Loyali yang'hali mnzila kuhiluka Misili, Musa nayali honhu ha kuwasa wajenzi, Mkulu Nguluwi nakating'hana na heye nakajeza kumkopola.
Aho Sipola nakahola iganga linoleche, nakalidumula igovi lya mwanage na kumdoliza nalyo Musa mmagulu yolonga, “Hegwe ndo mkasano wa danda”.
Aho Mkulu Nguluwi nakamleka Musa yawele mkomu. Sipola nayali yalonjile, “Mkasano wa danda,” kwa mbuli ya kwinjiza ikumbi.
Mkulu Nguluwi nakamlonjela Aluni, “Ulute kuchiwala ukating'hane na Musa.” Aluni nakaluta nakating'hana na Musa kuli chidunda cha Nguluwi, nakamnonela.
Na heye Musa nakamlonjela Aluni ulonzi weng'ha woyalonjelwe na Mkulu Nguluwi yalonje, na ulajilo weng'ha woyalajizwe na Nguluwi yadite.
Hamba Musa na Aluni nawaluta ako Misili, wawakungajiza wasekulu weng'ha wa Waisilaeli.
Aluni nakawalonjela ulonzi weng'ha Mkulu Nguluwi woyamlonjele Musa na kudita ula ulajilo hali wanhu weng'ha.
Wanhu weng'ha nawakunda. Nalowahuliche kuta Mkulu Nguluwi koya kuwatanza Waisilaeli na kuta nakona isungu kwa kugaya kwa hewo, weng'ha nawamfugamila Nguluwi.
